estimates.assumptions: 1 medium aubergine ~350g edible portion, raw; standard values ~3.8g carbs/100g including ~1.9g fiber
3 tbsp olive oil = 45ml total; pure oil contains no carbohydrates or fiber
140g dry couscous; standard dry values ~74g carbs/100g including ~4.8g fiber
225g prepared vegetable stock; low-carb ~0.5g carbs/100g, negligible fiber
200g cherry tomatoes, raw; ~4g carbs/100g including ~1.2g fiber
handful fresh mint ~15g; ~5g carbs/100g including ~4g fiber
juice of 1/2 lemon ~30g; ~8.3g carbs/100g including ~0.3g fiber
